name: nordbyte-nordrelay
description: NordRelay is a secure remote control bridge for coding agents, connecting Codex, Pi, Hermes, OpenClaw and Claude Code to Telegram/WebUI with streaming replies, sessions, files, voice, queues, artifacts and access controls.
